answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 3163 Country: India Title: What is the ruling for wearing pants above the ankles.all readymade pants available in market are long in length. and what i do is i fold it inside not outside to let it above the ankles iz it ok? Question: What is the ruling for wearing pants above the ankles.all readymade pants available in market are long in length. and what i do is i fold it inside not outside to let it above the ankles iz it ok? Answer ID: 3163 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 255/226=D) The pajama or pants should be worn above ankles. It is unlawful to wear such a long one which covers the ankles; it has been sternly prohibited in hadith . It is right to fold it above ankles. If the pant is so tight that the body structure is displayed or it creates problems in rukoo , sajdah and taharah then it is undesirable to wear it otherwise it is allowable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
